// xs_begin
// author : 'Rok test'
// arg : { name = 'Radius'  var = 'm_radius'  range = '1 64'  value = '5'  step = '1'  precision = '0' }
// xs_end

// The preprocessor features third-party shaders use: constants, function
// macros (nested, with ## and __VA_ARGS__), continued lines, #ifdef and
// #if with defined(), #undef, and lines Rok sets up itself.
#version 330
#extension GL_ARB_gpu_shader5 : enable
#pragma optimize(on)

#define PI 3.14159265
#define TAU (2.0 * PI)
#define SQ(x) ((x) * (x))
#define LEN2(a, b) (SQ(a) + SQ(b))
#define PICK(...) max(__VA_ARGS__)
#define GLUE(a, b) a ## b
#define CLAMP01(x) \
  clamp(x, 0.0, 1.0)
#define USE_BALL
#define DETAIL 2

#ifdef USE_BALL
float shape(vec3 p) { return sqrt(LEN2(p.x, p.y) + SQ(p.z)) - m_radius; }
#else
float shape(vec3 p) { return -1.0; }
#endif

#if defined(USE_BALL) && DETAIL > 1
float GLUE(detail, 2)(float d) { return CLAMP01(d / TAU); }
#elif DETAIL == 1
float detail2(float d) { return 0.0; }
#endif

#undef PI
#ifndef PI
float map(vec3 v) {
  float d = shape(v - i_volume_size * 0.5);
  return d <= 0.0 ? PICK(i_color_index, detail2(d)) : 0.0;
}
#endif
